profile.ja: はるか昔から生きている魔族の女性。その起源や来歴は謎に包まれている。魔界出身らしいが、はるか昔から人間界に住みつき、正体を隠し何度も名を変えながら世界中の裏社会を渡り歩いてきた。長命ながら「まだまだ二十代の小娘」と自称しているが、それを疑われない程度には演技力に長け、豊満で若々しい肉体と美貌を維持している。人の欲望が込められた物体から力を得る能力を持ち、あちこちで人間を誘惑しては彼女への欲望のこもった贈り物を貢がせ、それを自身の力の源としている。正体を知られそうになると初めからいなかったかのように姿を消すが、今いる場所を気に入っていたり、欲しいものがあるときは長居することもある。彼女は節制と欲望がせめぎ合う人間の葛藤から生み出される『澄んだ渇望≪ピュアグリード≫』を探し求めているが、人間の堕落が進んだ現代において、それを見つけ出すのは容易ではないようだ。春、若者たちが夢と希望を抱き、新生活へと足を踏み出す季節。若々しくひたむきな野望にこそ、長年探し続けた“渇望”の萌芽があるのではと考えた玉藻は、チアガール衣装に身を包み、応援の名目で品定めに出かけることにした。
profile.en: She is a demon woman who has lived for ages. Her origins and history are shrouded in mystery. Though apparently from the Demon Realm, she has resided in the Human Realm since ancient times, concealing her identity and adopting countless aliases while traversing the world's underworld. Despite being long-lived, she claims to be "still just a twenty-something girl," and her acting skills are sufficient to make others believe it; she maintains a voluptuous yet youthful body and beauty. She has the ability to gain power from objects imbued with human desire, and she uses this power to sustain her magical energy and preserve her youthful form and life. She does this by seducing humans and coaxing them into giving her gifts that are imbued with their desires, which she then uses to fuel her own power. When her true nature is about to be exposed, she disappears without a trace, but if she likes a place or has a target in sight, she will linger for as long as possible. She is searching for "Pure Greed," a desire that arises from the human struggle between restraint and desire, but it is becoming increasingly difficult to find in this corrupt world. In the spring, when young people are full of hope and dreams, Tamamo thinks that perhaps she can find the seeds of "Pure Greed" in their youthful and ambitious desires. She decides to dress up as a cheerleader and go out to scout for potential targets.

text.ja: この格好で若いオスから、欲望を搾ってやるかの――うっ！？　あ、あら隊長さん……いかがですか？　衣装をお見せしたくて、探していたんです
text.en: I was looking for you, Captain, to show you my new outfit... Hehe, what do you think?

text.ja: 節制と欲望の極致より生まれる、ピュアグリード……欲望はバカでかいが、節制するしかないとすると――やはり、若いオスを狙うべきじゃな？
text.en: Pure greed, born from the ultimate balance of restraint and desire... My desires are huge, but I have to control them, right? I suppose I should aim for a young man, then.

text.ja: うふふ、いかがですか？　チアリーダーの衣装を、私好みで発注してみたのですが……はしたなくはないでしょうか？
text.en: Hehe, what do you think? I had a cheerleader's uniform custom-made to my liking... It's not too embarrassing, is it?

text.ja: 若いのを誑かしておるところを、隊長殿に見られては大変じゃ……なぜかあやつは、妾が地をだしておるところに、やってくるからのう……
text.en: If the Captain sees me seducing a young one, it'll be trouble... For some reason, he always shows up when I'm making a move, and it's quite annoying...

text.ja: さて、学園内でオスを探すなら、気合いを入れんとな……教師連中やら、一部の実力者には、認識阻害も通用せん――ま、退屈しのぎにはよいか
text.en: Now, if I'm going to search for a man in the academy, I need to get motivated... The teachers and some of the strong ones won't be affected by my mind tricks, but it'll be a fun way to kill time, I suppose.

text.ja: ――だぁ～れだっ？　ふふっ、隊長さん、私ですよ♪　歓迎イベントの代行――という名目――で、お手伝いにきたんですよ～
text.en: —Who is it? Hehe, Captain, it's me. I came to help out with the welcome event... or so I'll call it.

text.ja: いいですねぇ、若い子たちのよくぼ――んんっ！　未来を見据えた、希望に満ちた輝きというものは。私もぜひ、あやかりたいものです
text.en: It's great, isn't it? The way young people shine with a bright, hopeful future... I'd love to experience that for myself.

text.ja: 隊長殿は、どうにも得難いものを真に欲しておるな……あるいはそれが、ピュアグリードの……しかし――あやつは、あまり誑かしたくないのう
text.en: The Captain desires something that's truly difficult to obtain... Perhaps that's what pure greed is. However, I don't want to seduce him that much.

text.ja: あらあら、いやらしい目をしてしまって……若いのに、ずいぶんとゲスな欲望だわ♪　さ、私の身体で存分に、吐き捨ててしまいなさい♪
text.en: Oh my, you're looking at me with such a dirty gaze... You're quite bold for someone so young, aren't you? Hehe, go ahead and indulge in my body, then.

text.ja: ふふっ、チンポから欲望ダダもれねぇ？　これがあなたの、最後の射精になるのよ――その若さと命の輝き、存分にムダ撃ちなさい？
text.en: Hehe, can't you see the desire overflowing from your body? This will be your last time, so go ahead and waste your youthful energy and vitality.
